steps.expression: return (input.scope.fetch_resources.data || []).map((loop_item, idx) => { const resources = (loop_item.fetch_resources.data.resources) || []; const project = input.scope.list_projects.data.projects[idx]; return { project: project.name, id: project.id, resource_count: resources.length, resources: resources.map((x) => x.urn) }; });
